name: opekunov/laravel-centrifugo-broadcaster
description: Centrifugo broadcaster for Laravel 8.75-11.x and Centrifugo >= 5.0

scripts.test:docker:setup: cd tests/Docker && docker compose up -d && cd ../.. && php tests/Docker/wait-for-server.php http://localhost:8001 http://localhost:8002
scripts.test:docker:setup:v5: cd tests/Docker && docker compose up -d centrifugo-v5 && cd ../.. && php tests/Docker/wait-for-server.php http://localhost:8001
scripts.test:docker:setup:v6: cd tests/Docker && docker compose up -d centrifugo-v6 && cd ../.. && php tests/Docker/wait-for-server.php http://localhost:8002
scripts.test:docker: cd tests/Docker && docker compose up -d && cd ../.. && php tests/Docker/wait-for-server.php http://localhost:8001 http://localhost:8002 && CENTRIFUGO_URL=http://localhost:8001 phpunit tests/Integration/; v5=$?; CENTRIFUGO_URL=http://localhost:8002 phpunit tests/Integration/; v6=$?; cd tests/Docker && docker compose down; exit $((v5 + v6))
scripts.test:docker:v5: cd tests/Docker && docker compose up -d centrifugo-v5 && cd ../.. && php tests/Docker/wait-for-server.php http://localhost:8001 && CENTRIFUGO_URL=http://localhost:8001 phpunit tests/Integration/; rc=$?; cd tests/Docker && docker compose down; exit $rc
scripts.test:docker:v6: cd tests/Docker && docker compose up -d centrifugo-v6 && cd ../.. && php tests/Docker/wait-for-server.php http://localhost:8002 && CENTRIFUGO_URL=http://localhost:8002 phpunit tests/Integration/; rc=$?; cd tests/Docker && docker compose down; exit $rc
